name: ProductBridge
description: AI agent that automatically collects user feedback across multiple platforms including Slack, Intercom, Trustpilot, G2, and ProductHunt. Uses AI to organize, deduplicate, and help teams prioritize features based on user feedback data. Features public roadmap, auto-changelog, and user notifications when requested features ship.
community_quotes: Feedback keeps coming in, but it rarely turns into clear product decisions. Really like how you've made it more structured and usable.
The 'closing the loop' part is what I care about most here. Telling users 'hey we shipped the thing you asked for' always falls through the cracks.
$24/mo flat is solid too. Most tools in this space charge per seat which gets painful fast.
Teams discovering that the same problem had been reported 12+ times — just never connected. Different words, different channels, different teammates receiving it.

name: GitAgent by Lyzr
description: Git-native open standard that transforms your repository into your AI agent's memory, skills, and identity. Define once and run anywhere from GitHub into Claude, OpenAI, CrewAI, OpenClaw without reformatting. Features versioning, branching, rollback, and PR capabilities for agent configurations.
community_quotes: Using the repo itself as the agent's memory makes way more sense than dumping everything into a system prompt or building separate context management.
We kept seeing teams pour weeks into building AI agents, only to realize all that IP was trapped inside whatever framework they chose.
Store agents in Git. Version them. Port them. Run them anywhere.
We're calling this #OwnYourAgents because if you built the agent, you should own it. Not the framework. Not the platform. You.

name: Claude Code Channels
description: Control your local Claude Code sessions remotely via Telegram and Discord. Built on Model Context Protocol (MCP), it enables sending commands, receiving CI alerts, and responding to external events from your phone while Claude Code executes tasks in your local environment.
community_quotes: Leverages MCP's new claude/channel capability type to turn messaging platforms into tool servers
Allows developers to interact with Claude Code through messaging platforms
Shipped by Anthropic as part of their MCP ecosystem

name: Composer 2 by Cursor
description: Fast, token-efficient frontier-level coding model that plans and executes multi-file edits across your entire codebase. Ranked #3 Product Hunt on March 20, 2026. Priced at $0.50 per million input tokens and $2.50 per million output tokens.

name: Claude Code Scheduled Tasks
description: Schedule recurring coding tasks with Claude Code across local desktop and cloud. Set repos, schedules, and prompts once for automated execution. Ideal for continuous workflows and agent-like development. Launched with 247 upvotes on Product Hunt.
